name: FFS_REPORT_SETTINGS
description: Used to store all report settings.

columns.name: RG_ID
columns.description: Id of the report group for the report settings.

columns.name: REPORT_ID
columns.description: Id of the report for the report settings.

columns.name: REPORT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the report for the report settings.

columns.name: REPORT_NAME_REF
columns.description: Name of the report for the report settings.

columns.name: REPORT_SIZE
columns.description: Comma separated value indicating height and width of report.

columns.name: ISMINIMIZED
columns.description: Boolean showing if the report is minimized.

columns.name: ISRESIZABLE
columns.description: Boolean showing if the report is resizable.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
